rationale: IBM's official IBM Cloud product page states the platform combines infrastructure, platform services, AI, and automation and describes AI capabilities. The dataset identifies the broad IBM Cloud service, so included AI services make the product AI-enabled. The source description emphasizes IaaS/virtual machines and does not date/version the specific represented service; applicability is somewhat uncertain.
ai_type_rationale: Infrastructure-as-a-service and virtual machines remain meaningful core services without AI; AI is a capability alongside them.
version_scope: Unversioned dataset description; current IBM Cloud portfolio documentation used, without proof of historical offering composition.
issues: No version/date for source-represented IBM Cloud; current portfolio applicability to the IaaS description is uncertain.

sources.excerpt: IBM Cloud is an enterprise cloud platform ... It combines infrastructure, platform services, AI, and automation
sources.applicability: Official IBM Cloud product page supports AI present in the named platform portfolio; precise overlap with listed IaaS components is uncertain.
